headline: Claude Code now lets sessions talk to each other on macOS
summary: The latest version of Claude Code introduces a new feature allowing AI sessions to message each other, facilitating shared findings and collaborative problem-solving.
details: Users running the latest version of Claude Code on macOS can now enable their AI sessions to communicate directly. This new capability allows sessions to share findings, ask questions, and exchange information seamlessly.

This inter-session communication aims to enhance the collaborative potential of Claude Code, enabling a more integrated workflow for developers and researchers. It streamlines the process of consolidating insights from multiple AI interactions.
caption:
Claude Code on macOS now allows its AI sessions to communicate directly.

Users running the latest version of Claude Code on macOS can now enable their AI sessions to communicate directly. This new capability allows sessions to share findings, ask questions, and exchange information seamlessly.

This inter-session communication aims to enhance the collaborative potential of Claude Code, enabling a more integrated workflow for developers and researchers. It streamlines the process of consolidating insights from multiple AI interactions.
